overview.description: Global X Funds - Global X LLM ETF is an exchange traded fund launched and managed by Global X Management Company LLC. It invests in public equity markets of global region. It invests in stocks of companies operating across interactive media & services and software sectors. The fund invests in growth and value stocks of companies across diversified market capitalization. Global X Funds - Global X LLM ETF was formed on September 30, 2026 and is domiciled in the United States.

data.title: Global X Launches New ETF Focusing on Large Language Models
data.text: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Global X launches the Global X LLM ETF (ticker LLMA), which seeks to provide targeted exposure to the companies building large language models.
